assets.title: A · 犬娘
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original anime mascot EAR + HAIR + FACE development sketch sheet, early exploration only.
Design an ORIGINAL head concept for a cute, friendly, slightly airheaded creative AI companion. This is a fresh design exploration after rejected generic fantasy illustrations. The character must have a strong independent silhouette and endearing personality, not an existing character or a recolored reference.
Scope and layout: a clean warm off-white portrait or square design-study sheet, one LARGE fully colored head-and-shoulders view occupying most of the sheet, one smaller clean side-head sketch showing the ear attachment and hair layers, a tiny single-color head-silhouette thumbnail, and exactly four small palette swatches. All views show the SAME proposed character design and coherent anatomy. No full-body figure, no chibi body, no character turnaround, no complex outfit. Only a very simple modest cream crewneck visible at shoulders, clothes are deliberately not being designed yet.
Art direction: expressive polished Japanese anime character-design rough, confident delicate lines with a few intentional construction strokes, mostly flat color with restrained soft shadows. Emphasize shape design, clear ear fold/attachment, hair mass, expressive eyes and SMALL MOUTH WITH ONE TINY UPPER CANINE TOOTH visible. Cute bewildered 'eh? I can try!' personality; slightly delayed reaction, friendly and eager. Face is human, no muzzle or animal nose; not realistic furry. No sexual framing.
Identity rules: no long lavender twin tails, no large hair bows, no navy-and-gold fantasy cape, no gem brooch, no crown, no maid uniform, no bone or pawprint accessory. Do not copy any published game or VTuber character. One very small understated open rounded-square hairclip may be used as the only invented shared motif, placed with the hair flow; no piles of symbols, tech hardware, holograms or tool props.
Keep all ears and hair fully visible with clear white margin. No busy background, no ornamental border, no logos, no watermark. Only a small title and the option letter as specified, no paragraphs of fake writing.
Option A, DOG GIRL — warm rounded shape language.
Palette: warm milk-apricot hair, a single small cocoa underlayer near the nape, muted teal eyes, cream. Four swatches correspond to these.
Ear design is the signature: two broad soft canine ears grown from the upper SIDES of the head, not perched tall on top. Each ear has a thick small root lifted slightly from the skull, a low rounded shoulder, and a clear forward fold halfway along; the folded flap is broad like a soft rounded trapezoid ending just above the temple, NOT an upright sharp triangle and NOT a long spaniel ear down the cheek. One ear base sits slightly more perked than the other. Cocoa fur on the backs of the short folded flaps with cream along the rims makes the fold readable against apricot hair. Only a small inner surface glimpse; visible overlapping fold edge and occlusion shadow, no cat-ear geometry. Exactly two animal ears, no visible human ears.
Hairstyle: a fluffy chin-length round bob with three chunky cheek-framing tufts, imperfect short side-swept fringe and one little bent sprout of hair. Subtle asymmetry between the two cheek tufts, pleasantly soft but not a generic perfectly spherical haircut. No ponytails or hair bows.
Face: warm curious round eyes, relaxed raised eyebrows, tiny uneven open smile with one little upper fang, slight tilt as if she just noticed something. More absent-minded puppy companion than refined princess.
The side sketch must clearly show the ear root and forward-overlapping soft flap separately from the hair.
Exact small title: "A · 犬娘".

Option B, FOX GIRL — broad expressive angular curves with a soft finish, not the usual white fox idol or shrine maiden.

Inner fluff arranged as TWO broad teardrop tufts rather than tiny spikes. Ink-blue outer ear with warm pearl fluffy inset; small dusty-coral inner surface visible. The side view clarifies the broad tilted ear base and short low knot, not a ponytail.

assets.title: D · 粉毛犬娘
assets.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: original anime mascot HEAD AND HAIR direction study, option D, pink LONG-HAIRED DOG GIRL.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and visual design-family reference, the apricot short-haired dog-girl head study A. Create a revised D study of this SAME adorable dog-girl with long soft pink hair, preserving her recognizable face identity, soft slightly airheaded eager personality, pretty teal eyes, and the SINGLE TINY UPPER CANINE TOOTH in her small open smile.
Make these changes:
1. Hair is a lovely low-saturation cherry-blossom pink with milk-pink light planes and gentle rose shadows, not lavender, orange or extremely vivid hot pink. Replace the short bob with LONG free-flowing hair down to the waist, fluffy at the crown and cheek-framing locks, mostly smooth broad strands above shoulders and a few broad S-shaped bends toward the ends. One slender loose side braid tucked through the long hair gives subtle asymmetry, not twin ponytails, no large bows or fancy princess curls. A soft bent little ahoge stays.
2. Preserve two clearly CANINE folded ears, warm rose-cocoa fur with cream tips. Refine them into broad soft folded flaps with short lifted roots and an obvious overlapping forward fold, compact rather than long ribbons down the cheeks, rounded canine tips rather than cat-ear sharp triangles. Ear flaps hang around the temple, not down to the jaw. The fold should be legible both in the main head view and profile inset. Human ears concealed by hair. Exactly two dog ears.
3. The expression is cute and guileless, with round teal eyes, relaxed gently lifted eyebrows, slightly tilted head, and a SMALL warm open smile showing one tiny fang. A little absent-minded, not smug, seductive, distressed or overly boisterous. Keep minimal blush.
Layout: a new clean warm off-white character-design-study sheet. One large main view from complete head to upper waist so the long hair reads clearly, the hair length and all ends inside the frame; one smaller side-profile head/upper body study showing the same long hair and dog ear fold; one small solid-color head-and-hair silhouette; four small swatches (sakura pink, rose cocoa, muted teal, cream). Keep the same delicate polished anime drawing family and restrained soft shading as A, intentional confident concept lines. Simple modest cream crewneck only, no costume design yet.
Keep the single very small plain open rounded-square hairclip from A as the only accessory. No dog bone, no paw charm, no gems, no cape, no gold filigree, no headwear, no gadget, no full body or legs, no chibi body, no separate animals, no decorative frame or background scene. Make the ear-and-hair silhouette independently memorable.
Exact title, and no other text: "D · 粉毛犬娘". All ears, ahoge, hair length and hair ends fully inside the sheet with margin.
